phone.linked.none.note: One line on the iPhone when no other device is linked.

phone.requests.title.note: Card title on the iPhone settings page for brains.

phone.requests.info.en: How long an Imp waits for its Brain, and what it does when the internet drops.
phone.requests.info.es: Cuánto espera un Imp a su cerebro y qué hace si se corta internet.
phone.requests.info.zh-Hans: Imp 等它的大脑要多久，以及网络断开时该怎么办。

phone.requests.timeout.info.en: If the Brain takes longer than this, the Imp stops waiting and says so.
phone.requests.timeout.info.es: Si el cerebro tarda más que esto, el Imp deja de esperar y lo dice.
phone.requests.timeout.info.zh-Hans: 大脑超过这个时间还没好，Imp 就不等了，并告诉你。

phone.requests.retries.info.en: How many times the Imp asks again when the internet drops. Wrong keys are never tried again.
phone.requests.retries.info.es: Cuántas veces vuelve a preguntar el Imp si se corta internet. Las claves erróneas no se reintentan.
phone.requests.retries.info.zh-Hans: 网络断开时，Imp 会再问几次。密钥错误则不会再试。

phone.requests.delay.info.en: How long the Imp rests before it asks again.
phone.requests.delay.info.es: Cuánto descansa el Imp antes de volver a preguntar.
phone.requests.delay.info.zh-Hans: Imp 再次提问之前先休息多久。

phone.requests.backoff.info.en: Each rest is this many times longer than the one before.
phone.requests.backoff.info.es: Cada descanso dura este número de veces más que el anterior.
phone.requests.backoff.info.zh-Hans: 每次休息的时间，都比上一次长这么多倍。

phone.shake.info.en: Shake the iPhone next to a linked device and the Imp you moved last goes there. You can undo it.
phone.shake.info.es: Agita el iPhone junto a un dispositivo enlazado y el último Imp que moviste va allí. Puedes deshacerlo.
phone.shake.info.zh-Hans: 在已关联的设备旁摇一摇 iPhone，你刚动过的 Imp 就会过去。可以撤销。

phone.shake.friends.title.note: Row title: ask before sending to a friend.

phone.linked.title.note: Title of the linked devices card.

phone.linked.info.note: Help of the linked devices card.
phone.linked.info.en: Devices linked with this iPhone. Imps can travel between you.
phone.linked.info.es: Dispositivos enlazados con este iPhone. Los Imps pueden viajar entre tus dispositivos.
phone.linked.info.zh-Hans: 与这台 iPhone 关联的设备。Imp 可以在你们之间旅行。

phone.forget.one.title.note: Alert button, with the device name.

phone.name.field.note: Placeholder of the field with this device name.

phone.name.title.note: Title of the card with this device name.

phone.scan.code.note: Button that opens the camera to scan a link code.

phone.paste.link.note: Button that links from a copied link.

phone.status.connected.note: Connection pill: linked and connected to a device.

phone.status.looking.note: Connection pill: a linked device is not reached yet.

phone.status.internet.note: Spoken label of the globe in the connection pill.

phone.status.hint.note: Spoken hint of the connection pill.

phone.stage.throw_hint.note: Empty main screen while another device is nearby.
phone.stage.throw_hint.en: Throw an Imp off the side of another screen. It lands here.
phone.stage.throw_hint.es: Lanza un Imp por el borde de otra pantalla. Aterriza aquí.
phone.stage.throw_hint.zh-Hans: 把 Imp 从另一块屏幕的边缘扔过来，它会落在这里。

phone.stage.nobody.note: Door label when the edge leads to no device.

phone.stage.back_to.note: Door label that sends an Imp back to the device it came from.

phone.code.caption.note: One line under the QR code.

phone.code.label.note: Spoken name of the QR code.

phone.connected.note: State of a linked device that answers.

phone.connected_hop.note: State of a linked device reached through The Hop.

phone.mine.note: Toggle: this linked device is mine.

phone.visiting.note: Imps of another device that are here now.

phone.with.note: Under an Imp that another device holds.

phone.callhome.label.note: Spoken name of the call home button.

phone.forget.message.en: Its Imps come home. To link again, show a new code.
phone.forget.message.es: Sus Imps vuelven. Para enlazar, muestra otro código.
phone.forget.message.zh-Hans: 它的 Imp 会回家。要再关联，请出示新的二维码。

phone.forget_all.title.note: Question above the forget everyone button.

phone.forget_all.message.en: Every Imp comes home. Link again with a new code.
phone.forget_all.message.es: Todos los Imps vuelven a casa. Enlaza otra vez con un código nuevo.
phone.forget_all.message.zh-Hans: 所有 Imp 都会回家。请用新的二维码重新关联。

phone.pair.seen_as.note: Help on the name card of the link sheet: what the name is for.
phone.pair.seen_as.en: Other devices see this iPhone by this name.
phone.pair.seen_as.es: Los otros dispositivos ven este iPhone con este nombre.
phone.pair.seen_as.zh-Hans: 其他设备会以这个名字看到这台 iPhone。

phone.pair.scan_other.en: Scan the code on the other device
phone.pair.scan_other.es: Escanea el código del otro dispositivo
phone.pair.scan_other.zh-Hans: 扫描另一台设备上的代码

phone.talks.empty.note: Empty state of the list of talks between Imps.

phone.talks.one.note: iPhone: the bar's subtitle while one talk is open (the list says Talks).

phone.talks.started_by_imp.note: iPhone: a talk row's icon, when the sheet's own Imp started the talk.

phone.talks.started_by_peer.note: iPhone: a talk row's icon, when the other Imp started the talk.

phone.talks.exchanges.note: iPhone: how many question and answer pairs a talk has, read out for its count.

phone.chat.ask_to_prefix.note: iPhone: the start of a message asking another Imp, sent to the Imp. The field does not show it.

phone.chat.ask_to.hint.en: Starts a message asking {name} to do something.
phone.chat.ask_to.hint.es: Empieza un mensaje pidiéndole algo a {name}.
phone.chat.ask_to.hint.zh-Hans: 开始一条请 {name} 做事的消息。

phone.chat.peers.note: iPhone: button beside the chat field that lists the other Imps to message.
phone.chat.peers.zh-Hans: 给其他 Imp 发消息

phone.secret.hidden.note: iPhone: what VoiceOver says for a key field while its value is hidden.

phone.stage.delete.body.en: Its chats and keys are forgotten. This can't be undone.
phone.stage.delete.body.es: Se olvidan sus chats y claves. No se puede deshacer.
phone.stage.delete.body.zh-Hans: 它的聊天和密钥都会被清除，此操作无法撤销。

phone.stage.move.body.en: {imp} moves in on {mac} for good, and its key goes with it. {mac} asks you to look it over first.
phone.stage.move.body.es: {imp} se va a {mac} para siempre y su clave se va con él. {mac} te pide que lo revises antes.
phone.stage.move.body.zh-Hans: {imp} 将永久搬到 {mac}，它的密钥也会一起带走。{mac} 请你先过目。

phone.pair.clipboard_empty.en: Copy the link from the other device first, then paste it here.
phone.pair.clipboard_empty.es: Primero copia el enlace del otro dispositivo y luego pégalo aquí.
phone.pair.clipboard_empty.zh-Hans: 请先在另一台设备上复制链接，再粘贴到这里。

phone.pair.clipboard_bad.en: The clipboard doesn't hold a link from Imp.
phone.pair.clipboard_bad.es: El portapapeles no contiene un enlace de Imp.
phone.pair.clipboard_bad.zh-Hans: 剪贴板里没有来自 Imp 的链接。

phone.pair.code_bad.es: Ese código no es de Imp.
phone.pair.code_bad.zh-Hans: 该二维码不是 Imp 的。

phone.pair.link_bad.en: That isn't a link from Imp.
phone.pair.link_bad.es: Ese no es un enlace de Imp.
phone.pair.link_bad.zh-Hans: 这不是来自 Imp 的链接。

phone.editor.save_failed_title.note: Title of the alert when an Imp's settings could not be saved.

phone.editor.save_failed.note: Message of that alert, with what went wrong.
phone.editor.save_failed.es: No se pudo guardar el Imp. {detail}

phone.persona.placeholder.note: Placeholder of the personality field of an Imp on the iPhone.
phone.persona.placeholder.en: Who is this Imp? How does it talk?
phone.persona.placeholder.zh-Hans: 这个 Imp 是谁？它怎么说话？

phone.brains.set_up.note: Button beside an Imp without a Brain (iPhone settings): opens its Brain to set one up.

phone.brain.change.note: Button in an Imp's Brain panel on the iPhone that starts choosing another service or model.

link.reset.note: Toast once when the saved links could not be read and were reset.
link.reset.en: Imp couldn't read its saved links, so it started fresh. Link your devices again.
link.reset.es: Imp no pudo leer sus enlaces guardados y empezó de nuevo. Enlaza tus dispositivos otra vez.
link.reset.zh-Hans: Imp 无法读取已保存的连接，已重新开始。请重新连接你的设备。

link.localnet.off.note: Status line when Local Network access is off for Imp.
link.localnet.off.en: Local Network is off for Imp
link.localnet.off.zh-Hans: Imp 的本地网络已被关闭

link.localnet.open.note: Button on the iPhone that opens the app's page in Settings.

link.localnet.open_mac.note: Button on the Mac that opens System Settings, Local Network.

link.preparing.note: Status line while the link is coming up and a code cannot be made yet.

phone.brains.empty.note: Empty state of the phone's list of Imps and their Brains.

phone.brains.default.note: Under the list of Imps in the iPhone's Brains settings: a new Imp (the + button) starts with this Imp's service, model and key.
phone.brains.default.es: Los Imps nuevos empiezan con el cerebro de {name}.
phone.brains.default.zh-Hans: 新的 Imp 会沿用 {name} 的大脑。

phone.brain.model_auto.note: Placeholder of the model field in an iPhone Imp's Brain form: left blank, the first model that chats is picked.

phone.brain.list_models.note: Button beside the model field (iPhone Brain form): lists the service's models to pick one.

phone.brain.check_save.note: Button of the Brain form of an Imp that already thinks: tries the new service and model, then keeps them.

phone.app.speech.note: Card title in the iPhone's App settings: the app's language and whether voices play by themselves.

phone.language.system.note: Language picker option on the iPhone: follow the iPhone's own language.

phone.language.next_open.note: Shown under the language picker on the iPhone after a change: iOS applies an app's language when it opens.
phone.language.next_open.en: Imp switches language the next time it opens.
phone.language.next_open.es: Imp cambiará de idioma la próxima vez que se abra.
phone.language.next_open.zh-Hans: Imp 会在下次打开时切换语言。

phone.start.title.note: Big title of the iPhone's first screen, over the sleeping first Imp. Imp is the app's name.

phone.start.subtitle.note: One sentence under the first screen's title: what Imp is.
phone.start.subtitle.en: A tiny helper that lives on your screen and thinks with the AI you choose.
phone.start.subtitle.es: Un pequeño ayudante que vive en tu pantalla y piensa con la IA que elijas.
phone.start.subtitle.zh-Hans: 一个住在你屏幕上的小帮手，用你选择的 AI 思考。

phone.start.wake_note.note: Under the first screen's main button (Wake Imp up): what waking it needs.
phone.start.wake_note.en: Paste a key from an AI service, or use a model on your Mac.
phone.start.wake_note.es: Pega una clave de un servicio de IA o usa un modelo de tu Mac.
phone.start.wake_note.zh-Hans: 粘贴 AI 服务的密钥，或使用你 Mac 上的模型。

phone.start.link_title.note: The first screen's second way to begin: link this iPhone with a Mac or another iPhone.

phone.start.link_detail.note: Under Link a device on the first screen: what linking gives you.
phone.start.link_detail.en: Bring Imps over from your Mac or another iPhone.
phone.start.link_detail.es: Trae Imps desde tu Mac u otro iPhone.
phone.start.link_detail.zh-Hans: 把 Imp 从你的 Mac 或另一台 iPhone 带过来。

phone.brain.model_auto_detail.note: Under Picked for you in the iPhone's model list: blank lets the Imp take the first model that chats when it wakes.
phone.brain.model_auto_detail.en: The first model that chats, chosen when it wakes.
phone.brain.model_auto_detail.es: El primer modelo que conversa, elegido al despertar.
phone.brain.model_auto_detail.zh-Hans: 唤醒时自动选择第一个能聊天的模型。

phone.brain.model_use.note: Row in the iPhone's model list when the search holds a name the service doesn't list: use that name as the model.

phone.haptics.title.note: Card title and switch in the iPhone's App settings: taps felt in the hand.

phone.haptics.info.note: Help of the Haptics switch on the iPhone.
phone.haptics.info.en: Taps in your hand when you pick something, when an Imp comes or goes, and when something works or fails.
phone.haptics.info.es: Toques en la mano al elegir algo, cuando un Imp llega o se va, y cuando algo sale bien o falla.
phone.haptics.info.zh-Hans: 选择内容、Imp 到来或离开、操作成功或失败时，手中会有轻触反馈。
